text.title: 12th India-EU Foreign Policy and Security Consultations Held in New Delhi
text.one_liner: India and the European Union held their 12th Foreign Policy and Security Consultations in New Delhi on 27 November 2026.
text.summary: India and the European Union conducted the 12th India-EU Foreign Policy and Security Consultations in New Delhi on 27 November 2026. text.title: Breakthrough in Tunnel-14 of Rishikesh-Karnaprayag Rail Project
text.one_liner: Indian Railways achieved the main tunnel breakthrough of the 6.59 km long Tunnel-14 in Uttarakhand's Rudraprayag district.
text.summary: Indian Railways successfully achieved the main tunnel breakthrough of Tunnel-14, measuring 6.59 km, in the Rishikesh-Karnaprayag Rail Project located in Uttarakhand's Rudraprayag district. The excavation connected the 4.7 km section from Portal-1 in Sumerpur and 1.79 km from Portal-2 in Marora. Specialized techniques like pre-excavation, multi-drifting, micropiles, and controlled daytime blasting were utilized to ensure safety under inhabited areas.

text.title: New technology developed for stable, tunable and scalable white LEDs
text.one_liner: Researchers developed a dual-protection strategy using halide perovskite nanocrystals to create stable, tunable white LEDs.
text.summary: Researchers from CeNS Bengaluru and IIT Delhi have developed an innovative dual-protection strategy to prevent colour blurring in halide perovskite nanocrystals used for white LEDs. By reducing halide vacancies with lead selenide and applying a 5 to 6 nanometre thick atomic layer deposition of aluminum oxide, they successfully stabilised white light emission. This technology enables flexible, cost-effective white-lighting technologies for smartphones and lighting.

Uses halide perovskite nanocrystals with formula CsPbX3.
Employs lead selenide treatment and aluminium oxide atomic layer deposition encapsulation.

text.title: Indian Army Aircraft Land on Gujarat Economic Corridor
text.one_liner: Four Indian Army aircraft successfully landed on the Amritsar–Jamnagar Economic Corridor in Patan, Gujarat.

text.title: First North-East India-Specific Antivenom Developed for Pit Vipers
text.one_liner: Researchers developed a novel bivalent antivenom targeting specific pit viper species common in Northeast India.
text.summary: A research team led by IASST Guwahati developed a novel equine F(ab)2 bivalent antivenom effective against the venom of Pope's pit viper and red-tailed bamboo pit viper found in Northeastern states like Mizoram and Meghalaya. text.summary: The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) and the Data Security Council of India (DSCI) signed a Memorandum of Understanding in New Delhi. The partnership focuses on developing protocols for trusted data sharing, privacy protection, and statistical confidentiality ahead of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. They will jointly prepare a policy paper on data flows and support privacy-enhancing technologies and AI use.

text.title: Government Approves 6 New Brownfield Urea Plants to Boost Self-Reliance
text.one_liner: The government approved 6 new brownfield urea plants under NIPU-2026 with an investment of ₹54,000 crore to achieve self-reliance.
text.summary: The Government of India has approved six new brownfield urea plants under the National Investment Policy for Urea (NIPU)-2026, involving an investment of approximately ₹54,000 crore. These projects are located in Tamil Nadu, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, and Rajasthan. The initiative aims to modernize aging legacy units, reduce high energy consumption, boost domestic manufacturing, and decrease import dependence against an annual national urea demand of around 400 Lakh Metric Tonnes.

text.title: Dr. Neelima Satyam Elected President-Elect of AGU Natural Hazards Section
text.one_liner: IIT Indore Professor Dr. Neelima Satyam has been elected President-Elect of the AGU Natural Hazards Section for 2027–2028.
text.summary: Dr. Neelima Satyam Devarakonda, an Institute Chair Professor in the Department of Civil Engineering at IIT Indore, has been elected President-Elect of the Natural Hazards Section of the American Geophysical Union (AGU) for the 2027–2028 term. This election marks a historic first for an Indian woman scientist to lead an AGU section while continuing to serve from an Indian academic institution, highlighting India's growing global research stature.

Serves as Institute Chair Professor at IIT Indore in the Department of Civil Engineering.

Previous recognitions include the 2025 AGU Natural Hazards Mitigation Award and the 2026 Devendra Lal Memorial Medal.

text.title: Senior Writer Dr. Sharankumar Limbale Elected President of 100th Sahitya Sammelan
text.one_liner: Senior writer Dr. Sharankumar Limbale has been elected as the president of the 100th Akhil Bharatiya Marathi Sahitya Sammelan.
text.summary: Senior author, thinker, and critic Dr. Sharankumar Limbale has been selected as the president for the 100th Akhil Bharatiya Marathi Sahitya Sammelan to be held in Pune. Expressing appreciation, Marathi Language Minister Dr. Uday Samant noted that Dr. Limbale's autobiographical work 'Akkarmashi' and his book 'Dalit Sahityache Saundyashastra' have significantly shaped Marathi literature by reflecting the realities of marginalized communities. He was also awarded the prestigious Saraswati Samman for his novel 'Sanatan'.

text.title: 20th Edition of WAVES Film Bazaar Concludes in Goa with 2,288 Delegates
text.one_liner: The 20th edition of WAVES Film Bazaar in Goa concluded with 2,288 delegates from 54 countries participating.
text.summary: The 20th edition of WAVES Film Bazaar concluded in Goa, bringing together 2,288 delegates from 54 countries alongside the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI). Organized by the National Film Development Corporation (NFDC), the event featured around 220 scheduled one-to-one co-production meetings, leading to two letters of intent for India-Chile co-productions and 14 MoUs nearing finalization. The bazaar also included cash grants, post-production awards, and a startup showcase.
